name: nifty-weekly-strangle-16d
title: NIFTY weekly short strangle, 16 delta
description: Sell the 16-delta call and the 16-delta put of the next NIFTY weekly expiry at the close 6 calendar days before it (about the session after the previous expiry). Take profit at half the credit, stop at a loss of twice the credit (checked at the close), else hold to cash settlement. Unlimited risk on both sides: one lot, and the margin sets the return.
references: The 16-delta strangle and managing winners at 50% are practitioner habits, not evidence: this spec tests them on NSE data
